title: prereg-extraction-v1 player output
description: Whether a preregistration was found, its platform and link, and the extracted field-map.

prereg_found.description: True if the paper embeds a preregistration.

platform.description: The registry platform, or null if none found.

link.description: The canonical registration link, or null if none found.

fields.description: The four extracted preregistration fields (null when no prereg / not recoverable).

confidence.description: Player's confidence in the prereg_found detection call.
